_source: Artificial Analysis, MiMo-V2.6-Flash (reasoning variant, benchmarked on Xiaomi's first-party API): https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/mimo-v2-6-flash, model record read 2026-11-07 (intelligenceIndex 26.73). Methodology: https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking. Xiaomi's API serves MiMo-V2.6-Flash (HF: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL); we serve MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD (RL plus a short MOPD stage), so weights may differ.

acceptance_bars._note: No published MiMo-V2.6-Flash score exists for these (Artificial Analysis has none; the model card has none). Bars come from comparable models' published numbers under other protocols (frames, prompts, dataset versions differ), so they are WEAKER EVIDENCE than a same-protocol reference: a floor that catches a broken encoder path, not proof of parity.

videomme_short.basis: Video-MME leaderboard, short videos w/o subtitles: Gemini 1.5 Pro 81.7, InternVL2.5-72B 82.8 (64 frames), Qwen2-VL-72B 80.1, GPT-4o 80.0 (video-mme.github.io). Whole-set w/o subtitles: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 70.5, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 64.3. We sample 32 frames (fewer than most of those), so the bar sits below the 72B-class short scores.

mmau_mini.basis: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B MMAU avg 65.60 (huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, split not stated); Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 77.5 on MMAU-v05.15.25 (huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct). lmms-lab-audio/mmau test-mini may not be the v05.15.25 answer set.

librispeech_clean.basis: LibriSpeech test-clean WER: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 1.22, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 1.8, Whisper-large-v3 1.8 (the Qwen model cards). lmms-eval's prompt and normalizer differ from those cards'.
